name: Tradesmen's Terrace
summary: Merchants and craftspeople gather in Tradesmen's Terrace along Darnassus's southern edge. Its auction house and shops connect travelers with goods from Teldrassil and beyond.

sections.title: The Commercial Hub of Darnassus
sections.body: Shops and merchants fill Darnassus's southern stretch in Tradesmen's Terrace. Kaldorei and travelers from across the Alliance find provisions, crafting supplies, and the city's central auction house here. Paths lead north to the Warrior's Terrace and west toward the Temple Gardens and the Temple of the Moon. Travelers bound for the wilds gather what they need here.

sections.title: Artisans and Traders
sections.body: Kaldorei shops favor quiet stone, timber, and woven goods shaped to live in harmony with nature. No roaring furnaces or smog rise from these workshops as they do in dwarven and human ones. Adventurers seeking trade contracts, repairs, or materials gathered from Teldrassil's boughs find northern Kalimdor's principal center of business here.

faq.answer: Tradesmen's Terrace is Darnassus's southern marketplace, where merchants and craftspeople gather around the city's central auction house.

faq.q: Where is the auction house in Darnassus?
faq.answer: Darnassus's auction house stands in Tradesmen's Terrace, where travelers, traders, and locals take part in citywide and Alliance commerce.

faq.q: How do I reach the other districts from here?
faq.answer: Paths lead north from Tradesmen's Terrace to the Warrior's Terrace and west toward the Temple Gardens and the Temple of the Moon.

faq.q: What kinds of vendors are found in this district?
faq.answer: General merchants, trade supplies, and craftspeople offering everyday goods, repairs, and goods made across Teldrassil can be found in Tradesmen's Terrace.

angles.text: As a night elf, you find busy trade in Tradesmen's Terrace, shaped to preserve Darnassus's peaceful canopy without the disruptive industry of other races.
As an Alliance traveler arriving through Rut'theran Village, you can find banking, auctioneers, and trade supplies in Tradesmen's Terrace before heading deeper into Kalimdor.
